title: Michel Legrand Legrand Piano I Love Paris CD Columbia Japan Pressing Jazz
conditionDescription: Pre-owned. Disc, jewel case and inserts show normal light wear consistent with age and storage. Please review photos for exact condition.
descriptionText:
Legrand Piano - Michel Legrand at the piano plays I Love Paris
(Columbia CK 10129). Collector's Choice Music. Digitally mastered from
the analog recording. Compact disc made in Japan.

With Guy Pedersen, bass and Gus Wallez, drums.

1. I Love Paris (from "Can-Can")
2. Autumn Leaves
3. Under The Bridges Of Paris
4. Paris In The Spring
5. Paris Canaille
6. April In Paris
7. A Paris
8. La Vie En Rose
9. Under Paris Skies
10. Paris Je T'Aime (Paris, Stay The Same)
11. The Song From Moulin Rouge
12. The Last Time I Saw Paris
13. I Love Paris (Reprise) (from "Can-Can")

Disc, jewel case and pictured inserts are included. You will receive the exact CD pictured.
